intro: The rentals pack, for equipment, party, car and tool hire: the products you hire out and their terms, each agreement from hand-out to return, and what is due back. Switch it on in Settings › Industry packs for the places that hire things out.
start: Switch the rentals pack on in Settings › Industry packs, for the places that hire things out.
Choose each product you hire out on Items, with its rates and deposit, then add its units: each unit is an asset of that product.
Reserve your first rental on Agreements, and hand it out when the customer collects it.
Check Returns due each day for what is late and what is due back.

tips: A product has one set of terms at each place. To change the rates, open the item; to change its name, picture or tax, change the product in the catalogue.

A unit is off the calendar while its asset is retired or has a maintenance job open. Take off for mending opens that job; Put back cancels one that has not started, and one under way is finished in Assets.
Without its own late rate, an item's late fee follows your rentals settings.
